# HW CompSoc — Component suitability assessment

Reviewed 2026-10-30. All 3,158 catalogue IDs assessed in the requested order.

Updated to reflect the completed Add/Optional showcase pass. Original decisions are retained; current statuses distinguish actual integrations, alternatives, review demonstrations and the Custom fallback. Production conditions remain explicit.

Future reassessment: {'Still deferred': 69, 'Review demonstration': 28}.

Accepted records: Review demonstration: 14; Integrated: 23; Selectable alternative: 4; Custom static alternative: 1.

## Decision meanings

- **Keep:** Retain an existing component or implementation policy in its stated scope. This can be review tooling, not necessarily a public feature.
- **Add:** Original recommendation to add this capability. Current implementation status separately records the completed showcase work; production content/service conditions still apply.
- **Optional:** Original recommendation for a conditional enhancement or alternative. Current status distinguishes integrated code, selectable alternatives, review demonstrations and a Custom fallback. Do not stack alternatives.
- **Later:** Has a specific possible use, but the required real content, scale, service, ownership, license or compatible version does not exist yet.
- **Do not add:** No justified role in the agreed current website, or conflicts with readability, identity, interaction or service boundaries. Not a claim of technical impossibility.
- **Developer only:** Useful implementation/maintenance guidance, with no visitor-facing element to add.
- **Reference only:** An example, guide, collection or alternative to consult if a specific need arises; not an independent feature selected for implementation.

## Method

- Every retained catalogue ID has a decision, a current-scope rationale, where/how guidance, a reconsideration condition, an alternative, a technical gate and links to the earlier D-series design decisions.
- The assessment order is shadcn/ui → Magic UI → Motion → React Bits → Lucide React. The subsequent implementation pass maps every Add/Optional row in implemented-upgrades.json. Each row now distinguishes integrated code, selectable alternatives, review demonstrations and a Custom static fallback.
- Named standard components and selected creative/API cases have explicit judgements. Repeated visual families and the icon long tail use disclosed product policies with entry-specific identity/context; the Review basis field tells you which. This is not a claim of separately visual-testing every icon or executing every creative component.
- The 170 Magic UI recipes each map to a named parent component and inherit its content/placement conditions. They remain reference examples, not 170 separate recommendations.
- Every canonical icon has a semantic use/no-use decision. Its file availability is checked against pinned lucide-react; the shortlist has explicit meanings. Unselected shapes are not technically forbidden: they have no current assigned meaning.
- Paid collections are assessed at the publicly named family level. Unlisted variants and inaccessible licensed source are not claimed to be individually inspected. Source/version/license/dependency review remains a gate before any conditional adoption.
- React Native entries accidentally present in the broader catalogue are retained for traceability and explicitly rejected for this React DOM site. Lucide inherited category metadata is resolved before grouping; raw source directives are not treated as user-facing categories.
- The installed Motion namespaces were inspected locally. AnimateView is absent from motion/react 14.8.0, so its possible use requires a deliberate compatible upgrade. Export presence does not prove browser behaviour.
- Original Add/Optional decisions are retained for traceability. Implementation status and current-use fields record subsequent completed showcase work; Original Later decisions now have a separate futureOutcome: Review demonstration or Still deferred. Current use does not mean approved production content or a connected service.
- Implementation status is distinct from the original recommendation and inventory snapshot. The 42 accepted records include overlapping API/topic rows, not 42 independent installed components. Custom fallback does not count as use of its upstream component. Original where/how and if/when describe intended production placement; implementedHow records the actual review example.

## shadcn/ui

The interface additions are implemented: Alert/Empty states, AspectRatio media, Field validation and Item document rows, plus conditional utility and reference controls. Marker is correctly used as a section/group label. Radio Group and Native Select are mutually exclusive review alternatives; production forms and document content remain conditional. The future pass also demonstrates Kbd, Checkbox, Toggle, Progress, Table and Pagination in the local source-project checklist.

No society login/OTP, chat/AI UI, desktop editor controls or wholesale primitive migration. Keep the current native top-level links.

Coverage: 142 entries. Do not add: 35; Later: 31; Optional: 14; Reference only: 28; Developer only: 16; Add: 5; Keep: 13.

### Chain of Thought — Do not add
`SH-docs-ai-elements-base-chain-of-thought` · Pattern · Public

- **Implementation status:** Not implemented
- **Current use:** Upstream component not present · Proposal/reference only; not added to the site.
- **Can it be used?** The official catalogue documents this component/recipe, but additional source was not installed or runtime-tested for this assessment.
- **Where:** No agentic conversation interface
- **How:** Do not add the Chain of Thought pattern to the public society pages; use normal information, document and contact surfaces.
- **If/when:** Only a separately justified, owned AI service would create this need.
- **Why:** Chain of Thought is an AI-interface composition. The six-page site has no approved chatbot, agent execution or model-selection service.
- **Alternative:** Existing Cards, status messages and resource links.
- **Technical gates:** Inspect the exact registry source, version and license before copying. Review internal dependencies explicitly; Chart/Carousel/Drawer and effects can bring extra engines or primitives. Retain current tokens and avoid a second implementation of an existing control/effect.
- **Design evidence:** D18. **Basis:** AI-interface scope policy.
- [Official entry](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/ai-elements/base/chain-of-thought)

## Magic UI

Shine Border remains the bounded animated accent. BentoGrid and neutral AvatarCircles are integrated optional compositions; static DotPattern/GridPattern are selectable guide backgrounds. Highlighter is represented by a Custom native mark alternative because its extra rough-notation engine was not adopted. The future pass adds a real source-project FileTree, a static literal Terminal and a reader-scoped ScrollProgress demonstration. Code Comparison was inspected and remains deferred because its additional highlighting/theme dependencies were not adopted.

No marquee partner wall, fake notifications, invented counters, custom cursor or stacked card-light effects. Recipes inherit their parent decision.

Coverage: 265 entries. Developer only: 2; Reference only: 178; Do not add: 68; Later: 11; Optional: 5; Keep: 1.

## Motion

Shared named variants and m + LazyMotion are implemented. The modular build emits a measured separate feature chunk; the portable HTML deliberately embeds it. Bounded orchestration, scope cleanup, visibility hooks and m.create(Card) are review demonstrations with Static/reduced-motion fallbacks; they do not imply live project activity. The future walkthrough now demonstrates scoped reader motion values and useAnimate SVG explanation. Version-gated replacements and paid widgets remain deferred.

No drag-only public task, perpetual decorative loop, scroll-speed text or premium page-cover transition. AnimateView is not exported by the pinned version.

Coverage: 148 entries. Reference only: 53; Optional: 8; Do not add: 32; Keep: 25; Add: 3; Later: 19; Developer only: 8.

## Lucide React

The small named-import semantic set now includes the accepted Clock, TriangleAlert, Handshake, BookOpen, CodeXml, Copy and Link uses alongside existing icons. Text labels retain meaning. Unselected catalogue icons remain unimported; icon availability is not an implementation claim. Six original Later icons now reinforce the local walkthrough: ArrowLeft, GitBranch, Terminal, Workflow, FileCode and ListFilter. Other technical symbols still lack distinct assigned content.

Do not use icon volume as decoration, invent account/services from symbols, replace actual brand marks or include React Native guidance in the web build.

Coverage: 2047 entries. Do not add: 1974; Developer only: 4; Keep: 35; Reference only: 3; Later: 25; Optional: 4; Add: 2.
